summary: Keep test-only collector and messaging baseline inputs out of the installed st3 package identity

replay.detail: No runtime behavior or replay change.

compatibility.detail: No executable, client, wire or harness behavior change. Nix checks retain mandatory OTLP export and historical messaging coverage.

downtime.detail: The Nix output identity changes once on adopting this packaging fix, which can trigger the usual service restart. Subsequent test-only collector or messaging baseline pin changes no longer change the runtime package identity or trigger a daemon restart. Executable behavior is unchanged; no additional recovery or interruption beyond the usual restart is introduced.

manual.detail: No manual installation or state changes required.

recovery.detail: No runtime or database recovery change.
